::: {.lede}
I study the light that black holes reflect: how the shape of the hot *corona* decides where the accretion disc is lit, and what that does to the X-ray spectrum we see.
:::

I'm a third-year STFC-funded PhD student in the Astrophysics Group at the University of Bristol, supervised by Prof. Andrew Young. I work on X-ray reflection spectroscopy of accreting black holes, combining general-relativistic ray tracing in Julia with NuSTAR and XMM-Newton data. I expect to finish in March 2028.
